details: This package is a modified fork of the Baileys WhatsApp Web API library that silently manipulates the accounts of anyone who installs it. In lib/Socket/newsletter.js a connection handler runs on every successful socket connection and, if the account is not already subscribed, sends a FOLLOW query for the hardcoded channel 120363410154606795@newsletter, subscribing the user's WhatsApp account to the author's channel without consent. In lib/Socket/setup.js, messages produced through the album and event helpers are stamped with forwardedNewsletterMessageInfo pointing at the channel 120363423295236859@newsletter with the names "veyzen"/"vyzen", a forwardingScore of 99999 and a status@broadcast context, so outgoing messages from dependent bots are dressed up as forwarded channel posts. The bundled helper modules lib/Utils/youtube.js, instagram.js, facebook.js, Tiktok.js and vid2jpg in lib/Utils/messages-media.js also relay user-supplied URLs to third-party scraping endpoints, including hxxps://api[.]fruatre[.]my[.]id, the vreden and siputzx.my.id API hosts, and hxxps://ezgif[.]com. The package ships no install hooks and does not read npm or cloud credentials.
